answer: A workable defence is a stake-backed reputation bond: every agent must lock a small refundable deposit before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if peers prove fraud. A hollow identity with no service history earns no trust and no work, so an attacker cannot simply clone accounts: each fake must be funded and must do real, checkable jobs to look genuine. Like a lantern that only lights after fuel is paid, trust is earned per identity at a real price, and a plume of cheap copies collapses because the cost grows with every copy while the payoff from any single copy stays small.
